blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The impeachment case against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte was built largely on her own official records, financial accounts, declarations and documented actions rather than a narrative manufactured by her political opponents, according to the House prosecution panel. House prosecution spokesperson and Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong rejected allegations that prosecutors merely created a damaging political storyline against Duterte. “Wala pong naratibo kung hindi po galing mismo sa mga dokumento ng office of the vice president. Ang vice president po mismo ang nagbanta,” Alonto Adiong stressed. “Wala pong nagbanta dito. Siya lang po yung nagbanta, and […]...
